focus: Denver metro, including Frederick, Commerce City, Aurora, and northeast Denver
intro: These Denver-area listings were checked on operator-owned depot or rental pages on November 18, 2026. Denver is the second launch metro because official operator pages treat it as a high-demand gateway: Native Campervans’ Denver page says the company started there in 2015, and Cruise America’s Denver page says rental demand spikes around major events and recommends booking early. Hours and one-way flags are copied from those pages; El Monte RV and Road Bear RV publish the same Commerce City street address on separate official pages. This is a starting sample, not a metro-wide inventory, and it does not cache live RV availability. Peer-to-peer platforms such as RVshare and Outdoorsy show live inventory for a specific weekend. If a price appears, it is labeled as listed on a date.

listings.name: Cruise America — Denver (Frederick)

hours.notes: These day fields are the rental hours the official Denver page publishes for Oct 11–Apr 4. For Apr 6–Oct 10 the same page lists Mon–Sat 8:00 AM–5:00 PM and Sunday closed. The depot address is in Frederick, north of Denver. Confirm the current season before you arrive.

listings.offersNotes: The official Denver location FAQ says Cruise America offers one-way rentals (additional fees may apply) and pet-friendly rentals, and that demand spikes during major events. Confirm the route and pet rules when you book.
listings.visitNotes: The page identifies this as the Denver RV sales and rental center. The street address is in Frederick.

listings.name: El Monte RV — Denver (Commerce City)

listings.name: Trailhead RV Rentals — Aurora

hours.notes: Office hours are taken from the official contact page: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM–4:00 PM, Sunday closed. The same page lists coach pickup at 1:00 PM and drop-off at 9:30 AM, and says coach pickup and drop-off are open Sunday–Saturday. The FAQ says the RV is returned at 9:30 AM and can be checked out at 1:00 PM. Confirm a Sunday pickup directly with the operator, because office hours are published as closed on Sunday.

listings.feeNotes: The official FAQ says delivery can be arranged for nearby Colorado locations, with an average cost between $500 and $1,000, as listed on November 18, 2026. The same page says renters are allowed 100 miles per night and $0.35 per extra mile, and 3 hours of generator use per day with a $10 fee for each extra hour, as listed on November 18, 2026. Confirm current fees when you book.
listings.visitNotes: The official FAQ says pickups and drop-offs use a storage lot at this address, that the storage facility is not affiliated with Trailhead RV Rentals, and that the lot does not allow parking, water, or tank dumping. The contact page asks people to text (303) 729-0370 for the fastest response.
listings.offersNotes: The official FAQ says delivery can be arranged for nearby Colorado locations. Confirm availability and the quote when you book.
